SlowpokeWellB1FKurtText:
KURT: Hey there,
{PLAYER}!

The guard up top
took off when I shouted at him.

But then I took a
tumble down the WELL.

I slammed down
hard on my back, so I can't move.

Rats! If I were
fit, my #MON

would've punished
them…

Ah, it can't be
helped.

{PLAYER}, show them
how gutsy you are in my place!
KurtLeaveSlowpokeWellText:
KURT: Way to go,
{PLAYER}!

TEAM ROCKET has
taken off.

My back's better
too. Let's get out of here.
GruntM29SeenText:
Darn! I was stand-
ing guard up top

when some old coot
yelled at me.

He startled me so
much that I fell down here.

I think I'll vent
my anger by taking it out on you!
GruntM29BeatenText:
Arrgh! This is NOT
my day!
GruntM29AfterBattleText:
Sure, we've been
hacking the tails

off SLOWPOKE and
selling them.

Everything we do
is for profit.

That's right!
We're TEAM ROCKET,

and we'll do any-
thing for money!
GruntM1SeenText:
What do you want?

If you interrupt
our work, don't expect any mercy!
GruntM1BeatenText:
You did OK today,
but wait till next time!
TrainerGruntM1WhenTalkText:
Yeah, TEAM ROCKET
was broken up three years ago.

But we continued
our activities underground.

Now you can have
fun watching us stir up trouble!
GruntM2SeenText:
Quit taking SLOW-
POKETAILS?

If we obeyed you,
TEAM ROCKET's rep would be ruined!
GruntM2AfterBattleText:
We need the money,
but selling SLOW- POKETAILS?

It's tough being a
ROCKET GRUNT!
GruntF1SeenText:
Stop taking TAILS?

Yeah, just try to
defeat all of us!
GruntF1AfterBattleText:
SLOWPOKETAILS
grow back fast!

What's wrong with
selling them?
SlowpokeWellB1FSlowpokeWithMailText:
A SLOWPOKE with
its TAIL cut off…

Huh? It has MAIL.
Read it?
SlowpokeWellB1FSlowpokeMailText:
{PLAYER} read the
MAIL.

Be good and look
after the house

with Grandpa and
SLOWPOKE.

Love, Dad
SlowpokeWellB1FTaillessSlowpokeText:
A SLOWPOKE with
its TAIL cut off…
